description:
BRIME! Instrumentals is the instrumental version of the BRIME! EP that originally featured Brazilian rappers Febem and Fleezus. The successful release of the original project received praise around the world, in particular the UK and Brazil, and received media support from Resident Advisor and DJ Mag. The cross-continental project mixes Brazilian musical references like Baile Funk with UK Grime. Now, for the first time, CESRV is proud to present the instrumentals for the first time ever.

All tracks produced by CESRV
